newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-NO PLACE FOR CAMINERO IN UNCHANGED SPANISH SQUAD.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NO PLACE FOR CAMINERO IN UNCHANGED SPANISH SQUAD.

text.p: Spanish soccer coach Javier Clemente has stuck by the players who beat Yugoslavia in December for Spain's World Cup qualifier against Malta next week.
The Spanish squad will once again be based around seven Barcelona men, meaning there is still no place for out of sorts Atletico Madrid midfielder Jose Luis Caminero.
"I wouldn't have picked myself either," confessed Caminero.

Atletico coach Radomir Antic tried to lift the spirits of his troubled playmaker earlier this week by handing the club captaincy to Caminero, who was booed by Atletico fans on his last home appearance.
Clemente has stuck by Real Madrid reserve goalkeeper Santiago Canizares, despite indicating recently that he would not pick keepers who did not play regularly.
Midfielder Roberto Rios and striker Alfonso Perez have also retained their places after fine work at the helm of Real Betis's championship challenge.
Spain currently top Group Six with 13 points from five games. Malta, who lost 3-0 at home to Spain in December, have yet to gain a point or score a goal in four games.

Squad: Goalkeepers - Andoni Zubizarreta (Valencia) Santiago Canizares (Real Madrid). Defenders - Abelardo Fernandez, Albert Ferrer, Sergi Barjuan, Miguel Angel Nadal (Barcelona), Rafael Alkorta (Real Madrid), Agustin Aranzabal (Real Sociedad). Midfielders - Luis Enrique Martinez, Josep Guardiola (Barcelona), Julen Guerrero (Athletic Bilbao), Fernando Hierro (Real Madrid), Roberto Rios (Real Betis). Strikers: Kiko Narvaez (Atletico Madrid), Juan Pizzi (Barcelona), Alfonso Perez (Betis), Javier Manjarin (Deportivo Coruna), Raul Gonzalez (Real Madrid).
